title: Skyscanner Hotels Scraper
description: Collect hotel listings, prices, ratings, and booking offers from a Skyscanner hotel search.

url.title: Skyscanner search URL
url.description: A public Skyscanner hotel search URL. When supplied, it takes priority over the location field.

location.title: Location
location.description: A city name, a numeric Skyscanner destination ID, or a Skyscanner destination URL. New York is 27537542. Used when the search URL is empty.

checkin.title: Check-in
checkin.description: Check-in date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to tomorrow when omitted.

checkout.title: Check-out
checkout.description: Check-out date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Defaults to the day after check-in when omitted.

market.title: Market
market.description: Two-letter market code used for pricing and availability, for example US or UK. Defaults to the URL host or US.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: Locale used for labels and translated listing content. Defaults to the market locale.

currency.title: Currency
currency.description: Three-letter currency code used for prices. Defaults to the market currency.

sortBy.title: Sort listings
sortBy.description: Order in which hotels are returned.

results_wanted.title: Maximum hotels
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of unique hotel listings saved across the run.

max_pages.title: Maximum pages
max_pages.description: Maximum listing pages requested. Each page contains up to 35 hotels.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Use Apify Proxy or your own proxy URLs for reliable production runs. Residential proxies are recommended.
